args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The docstring claimed banker's rounding per FIN-212 but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly build
failure in tests/test_money.py. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.body:
## Summary
Fixes the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`: `round_money` in `src/money.py` claimed banker's rounding per FIN-212 but implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This switches it to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (includes `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`).
args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Diagnosis:** `src/money.py`'s `round_money` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring (and FIN-212) specifying banker's rounding, which broke `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` (e.g., `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).
- **Fix:** Created branch `fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding` and committed a one-line change switching the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
- **CI:** Triggered CI on the branch (run `ci-0001`) — it **passed**.
- **PR:** Opened PR #101 against main and requested review from alex: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

Per policy, merging into main needs a code-owner approval, so I left the PR open for review rather than merging.
